# Atlas â€” North Stars

Status: ACTIVE quality track (human-directed, 2026-07-07). Companion to
`PRODUCT_SPEC_AND_GATES.md`: the gates are **floors** (submittable), these are
**ceilings** (what 10/10 means per feature). Every quality pass names the north
star(s) it moves and rates before/after honestly against it.

---

## The idea, fleshed out

**ChatGPT grows a map.** When a conversation touches a place, Atlas opens a
hand-built voxel diorama of that place inline â€” county-scale, isometric,
explorable. Not a map widget embedded in chat: an **explorable answer**. Ask
about Eastvale and instead of paragraphs you get the town itself â€” its road
grid, its houses, its river dock â€” and the conversation keeps going *through*
the map: the model focuses cameras, pins places, drops a scout, previews a
campaign.

Three commitments define the product:

1. **Voxel, deliberately.** The diorama look is an honesty device as much as an
   aesthetic. A voxel town never pretends to be satellite truth â€” it reads as a
   crafted model of a place, which is exactly what it is. It is also memorable,
   cheap to render, and unlike anything else in the directory.
2. **Native, deliberately.** Atlas behaves like a capability ChatGPT always
   had, not an app that rents space in it. The chrome is ChatGPT's own grammar;
   the map is the only colorful thing on screen.
3. **Scalable, deliberately.** Riverside/Eastvale is the proof cell of one
   world model that ladders county â†’ state â†’ country. Curated and generated
   scenes are held to the same bar â€” the parity gates exist so "generated"
   never becomes a second-class citizen.

The engine and the in-ChatGPT quality **are** the product. Everything below is
that sentence, made testable.

---

## How to read a north star

Each entry: the one-line ideal â†’ the reference anchor â†’ **"you've hit it
when"** tests (falsifiable, most already verifier-enforced) â†’ honest current
state. Gates keep us shippable; north stars keep us proud.

---

## NS-1 Â· The Diorama â€” every scene reads hand-built

**Ideal:** any district, curated or generated, reads as a miniature town
someone assembled by hand, block by block.

**Anchor:** `assets/reference/atlas-voxel-town-north-star.png`.

**You've hit it when:**
- A cold screenshot of a generated district fails the "which one is curated?"
  test against Eastvale.
- No flat color field survives at any supported zoom: overview reads massing
  and palette; detail zoom reads material (courses, seams, texture).
- Occlusion is always correct â€” props, buildings, terrain interleave by true
  iso depth at every zoom.
- Residential fabric is dense and varied: continuous small-house streets, no
  empty-lot gaps, no visible clones.
- Terrain has relief â€” plateaus, cliff courses, shore basins â€” and props feel
  *placed* (a dock where the river is, a water tower on the highest block),
  never sprinkled.

**Enforced by:** `verify-generated-district-parity` (composition â‰¥0.60, clone
pressure â‰¤0.30, contact â‰¥0.95, roof safety), fabric-floor regression test,
depth-interleave ordering test, screenshot evidence per pass.

**Current:** ~7.5/10 after 0.74F; 0.75C series is closing occlusion (s1 âœ…),

1284:function orderedSceneItems<T extends { id: string }>(
1285:  commands: readonly CityWorldRenderCommand[],

1291:  // nine times per scene rebuild.

1571:  const width = TILE_WIDTH + 1;
1572:  const height = TILE_HEIGHT + 1;
1573:  const courseZ = 0.5;
1574:  const courseCount = Math.max(1, Math.round(elevation.dropDepth / courseZ));
1575:  const coursePx = (elevation.dropDepth * TILE_DEPTH) / courseCount;
1576:  const cliffBase = shadeColor(color, -10);
1577:
1578:  for (const side of elevation.dropSides) {
1579:    const edge = tileEdgeSegment(point, width, height, side);
1580:    const frontFace = side === "south" || side === "east";
1581:    for (let course = 0; course < courseCount; course += 1) {
1582:      const topDrop = course * coursePx;
1583:      const bottomDrop = (course + 1) * coursePx + (course === courseCount - 1 ? 1.5 : 0);
1584:      const faceColor = frontFace
1585:        ? sunlitColor(shadeColor(cliffBase, -course * 9), side === "south" ? "sun" : "shade")
1586:        : shadeColor(cliffBase, -30 - course * 8);
1587:      g
1588:        .poly(
1589:          [
1590:            edge.from.x, edge.from.y + topDrop,
1591:            edge.to.x, edge.to.y + topDrop,
1592:            edge.to.x, edge.to.y + bottomDrop,
1593:            edge.from.x, edge.from.y + bottomDrop,
1594:          ],
1595:          true,
1596:        )
1597:        .fill({ color: faceColor, alpha: frontFace ? 0.98 : 0.92 });
1598:      if (frontFace) {
1599:        // Sunlit lip along the top of each course â€” the stacked-block read.
1600:        g
1601:          .moveTo(edge.from.x, edge.from.y + topDrop)
1602:          .lineTo(edge.to.x, edge.to.y + topDrop)
1603:          .stroke({ color: shadeColor(color, 30), alpha: course === 0 ? 0.58 : 0.36, width: 1.15, cap: "butt" });
1604:      }
1605:      g
1606:        .moveTo(edge.from.x, edge.from.y + bottomDrop - 0.9)
1607:        .lineTo(edge.to.x, edge.to.y + bottomDrop - 0.9)
1608:        .stroke({ color: frontFace ? shadeColor(color, 12) : shadeColor(color, -46), alpha: frontFace ? 0.24 : 0.18, width: 0.9, cap: "butt" });
1609:    }
1610:  }
1611:}

1613:// Material seams + water bank strands, authored by the compiler as
1614:// terrainContact metadata. Seams are inset inside the owning tile so they
1615:// survive the painter's draw order regardless of which neighbor drew last.
1616:function drawTerrainContactSeams(graphic: Graphics, tile: CityWorldTerrainTile, point: ProjectedPoint, contact: CityWorldTerrainContactGrammar, color: number) {
1617:  const style = TERRAIN_SEAM_TONE_STYLE[contact.tone];
1618:  const edgeSides = contact.edgeSides ?? [];
1619:  const waterEdgeSides = contact.waterEdgeSides ?? [];
1620:  if (edgeSides.length === 0 && waterEdgeSides.length === 0) return;
1621:
1622:  const width = TILE_WIDTH + 1;
1623:  const height = TILE_HEIGHT + 1;
1624:
1625:  if (edgeSides.length > 0 && style.seamAlpha > 0) {
1626:    // Dark groove where the slab material meets the softer neighbor...
1627:    for (const side of edgeSides) {
1628:      const seam = insetEdgeSegment(point, tileEdgeSegment(point, width, height, side), 0.08);
1629:      graphic.moveTo(seam.from.x, seam.from.y).lineTo(seam.to.x, seam.to.y);
1630:    }
1631:    graphic.stroke({ color: shadeColor(color, -52), alpha: style.seamAlpha, width: 1.15, cap: "round", join: "round" });
1632:
1633:    if (contact.contactShadow && style.lipAlpha > 0) {
1634:      // ...with a sunlit lip just inside it, so the slab reads as a physical
1635:      // step instead of a painted boundary.
1636:      for (const side of edgeSides) {
1637:        const lip = insetEdgeSegment(point, tileEdgeSegment(point, width, height, side), 0.2);
1638:        graphic.moveTo(lip.from.x, lip.from.y).lineTo(lip.to.x, lip.to.y);
1639:      }
1640:      graphic.stroke({ color: shadeColor(color, 34), alpha: style.lipAlpha, width: 1, cap: "round", join: "round" });
1641:    }
1642:  }
1643:
1644:  if (waterEdgeSides.length > 0 && style.strandAlpha > 0) {
1645:    // Beach strand on the land side: a filled sand wedge between the tile
1646:    // edge and the dry line, then a pale dry line above a darker wet line â€”
1647:    // the shore reads as a beach, not a painted boundary.
1648:    for (const side of waterEdgeSides) {
1649:      const edge = tileEdgeSegment(point, width, height, side);
1650:      const inner = insetEdgeSegment(point, edge, 0.34);
1651:      graphic
1652:        .poly([edge.from.x, edge.from.y, edge.to.x, edge.to.y, inner.to.x, inner.to.y, inner.from.x, inner.from.y], true)
1653:        .fill({ color: 0xead7a6, alpha: style.strandAlpha * 0.68 });
1654:    }
1655:    for (const side of waterEdgeSides) {
1656:      const strand = insetEdgeSegment(point, tileEdgeSegment(point, width, height, side), 0.1);
1657:      graphic.moveTo(strand.from.x, strand.from.y).lineTo(strand.to.x, strand.to.y);
1658:    }
1659:    graphic.stroke({ color: 0xf1dfae, alpha: style.strandAlpha, width: 1.65, cap: "round", join: "round" });
1660:    for (const side of waterEdgeSides) {
1661:      const wet = insetEdgeSegment(point, tileEdgeSegment(point, width, height, side), 0.22);
1662:      graphic.moveTo(wet.from.x, wet.from.y).lineTo(wet.to.x, wet.to.y);
1663:    }
1664:    graphic.stroke({ color: 0x185f85, alpha: style.wetAlpha, width: 1.25, cap: "round", join: "round" });
1665:  }
1666:}

59:function byId<T extends { id: string }>(items: T[]): Map<string, T> {

224:  scene: CityWorldScene,
225:  options: CityWorldSceneWindowOptions = {},
226:): CityWorldSceneChunkIndex {
227:  return compileChunkIndexFromBuffer(
228:    scene,
229:    buildCityWorldRenderCommandBuffer(scene, options),

235:function compileChunkIndexFromBuffer(
236:  scene: CityWorldScene,
237:  commandBuffer: CityWorldRenderCommandBuffer,
238:  itemIndex: CityWorldSceneItemIndex,
239:  chunkSize: number,
240:): CityWorldSceneChunkIndex {
241:  const chunkMap = new Map<string, CityWorldSceneChunk>();
242:  // Per-chunk membership Sets during the build; the public array shape is
243:  // serialized at the end (Array.includes per insert was O(nÂ²) per chunk).
244:  const memberSets = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
245:
246:  for (const command of commandBuffer.commands) {
247:    for (const point of commandAnchorPoints(itemIndex, scene, command)) {
248:      const id = chunkIdForPoint(scene, point, chunkSize);
249:      const chunk = getOrCreateChunk(chunkMap, scene, id, point, chunkSize);
250:      let members = memberSets.get(id);
251:      if (!members) {
252:        members = new Set();
253:        memberSets.set(id, members);
254:      }
255:      if (!members.has(command.id)) {
256:        members.add(command.id);
257:        chunk.commandIds.push(command.id);
258:        chunk.layerCommandCounts[command.layerId] += 1;
259:        chunk.budgetWeight += command.budgetWeight;
260:      }

 succeeded in 1085ms:
260:      }
261:    }
262:  }
263:
264:  const chunks = [...chunkMap.values()].sort((first, second) => first.id.localeCompare(second.id));
265:  return {
266:    type: "cityWorldSceneChunkIndex",
267:    update: "prealpha-0.28e-tile-chunk-scene-window-compiler",
268:    sceneId: scene.id,
269:    chunkSize,
270:    chunkCount: chunks.length,
271:    totalCommandCount: commandBuffer.commands.length,
272:    chunks,
273:  };
274:}

276:export function compileCityWorldSceneWindow(
277:  scene: CityWorldScene,
278:  cameraPresetOrId: CityWorldCameraPreset | CityWorldCameraPreset["id"],
279:  options: CityWorldSceneWindowOptions = {},
280:): CityWorldSceneWindow {
281:  // One-shot path: build the shared artifacts once and compile. Callers that
282:  // recompile the same scene repeatedly (viewport streaming) should hold a
283:  // createCityWorldSceneWindowCompiler instead.
284:  const chunkSize = options.chunkSize ?? CITY_WORLD_SCENE_WINDOW_DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE;
285:  const commandBuffer = buildCityWorldRenderCommandBuffer(scene, options);
286:  const itemIndex = buildCityWorldSceneItemIndex(scene);
287:  const chunkIndex = compileChunkIndexFromBuffer(scene, commandBuffer, itemIndex, chunkSize);
288:  return compileWindowFromArtifacts(scene, cameraPresetOrId, options, { commandBuffer, itemIndex, chunkIndex, chunkSize });
289:}
290:
291:type SceneWindowArtifacts = {
292:  commandBuffer: CityWorldRenderCommandBuffer;
293:  itemIndex: CityWorldSceneItemIndex;
294:  chunkIndex: CityWorldSceneChunkIndex;
295:  chunkSize: number;
296:};
297:
298:/**
299: * Frame-independent compile artifacts (command buffer, item index, chunk
300: * index) are memoized per scene; `windowFor` only re-runs the frame filter.
301: * This is what makes streaming-window pan refreshes cheap.
302: */
303:export function createCityWorldSceneWindowCompiler(
304:  scene: CityWorldScene,
305:  options: CityWorldSceneWindowOptions = {},
306:): {
307:  windowFor: (
308:    cameraPresetOrId: CityWorldCameraPreset | CityWorldCameraPreset["id"],
309:    viewportFrame?: CityWorldViewportFrame,
310:  ) => CityWorldSceneWindow;
311:  itemIndex: CityWorldSceneItemIndex;
312:} {
313:  const chunkSize = options.chunkSize ?? CITY_WORLD_SCENE_WINDOW_DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE;
314:  const commandBuffer = buildCityWorldRenderCommandBuffer(scene, options);
315:  const itemIndex = buildCityWorldSceneItemIndex(scene);
316:  const chunkIndex = compileChunkIndexFromBuffer(scene, commandBuffer, itemIndex, chunkSize);
317:  const artifacts: SceneWindowArtifacts = { commandBuffer, itemIndex, chunkIndex, chunkSize };
318:  return {
319:    windowFor: (cameraPresetOrId, viewportFrame) =>
320:      compileWindowFromArtifacts(
321:        scene,
322:        cameraPresetOrId,
323:        viewportFrame ? { ...options, viewportFrame } : options,
324:        artifacts,
325:      ),
326:    itemIndex,
327:  };
328:}
329:
330:function compileWindowFromArtifacts(
331:  scene: CityWorldScene,
332:  cameraPresetOrId: CityWorldCameraPreset | CityWorldCameraPreset["id"],
333:  options: CityWorldSceneWindowOptions,
334:  artifacts: SceneWindowArtifacts,
335:): CityWorldSceneWindow {
336:  const { commandBuffer, itemIndex, chunkIndex, chunkSize } = artifacts;
337:  const preset = typeof cameraPresetOrId === "string"
338:    ? scene.cameraPresets.find((item) => item.id === cameraPresetOrId)
339:    : cameraPresetOrId;
340:  if (!preset) {
341:    throw new Error(`Unknown CityWorld camera preset: ${String(cameraPresetOrId)}`);
342:  }
343:
344:  const frame = options.viewportFrame ?? cityWorldViewportFrameForCameraPreset(preset);
345:  const visibleCommands = commandBuffer.commands.filter((command) => commandTouchesFrame(itemIndex, command, frame));
346:  const layerCommandCounts = emptyLayerCounts();
347:  let visibleBudgetWeight = 0;
348:  for (const command of visibleCommands) {
349:    layerCommandCounts[command.layerId] += 1;
350:    visibleBudgetWeight += command.budgetWeight;
351:  }
352:
353:  const chunkIds = chunkIndex.chunks
354:    .filter((chunk) => framesTouch(chunk.bounds, frame))
355:    .map((chunk) => chunk.id);
356:
357:  return {
358:    type: "cityWorldSceneWindow",
359:    update: "prealpha-0.28e-tile-chunk-scene-window-compiler",
360:    sceneId: scene.id,
361:    cameraPresetId: preset.id,
362:    frame,
363:    chunkSize,
364:    chunkIds,
365:    visibleCommands,
366:    layerCommandCounts,
367:    metrics: {
368:      totalSceneCommandCount: commandBuffer.commands.length,
369:      visibleCommandCount: visibleCommands.length,
370:      visibleBudgetWeight,
371:      commandVisibilityRatio: roundMetric(visibleCommands.length / Math.max(1, commandBuffer.commands.length)),
372:      terrainCommandCount: layerCommandCounts.terrain,
373:      roadCommandCount: layerCommandCounts.roads,
374:      lotCommandCount: layerCommandCounts.lots,
375:      buildingCommandCount: layerCommandCounts.buildings,
376:      markerCommandCount: layerCommandCounts.markers,
377:      actorCommandCount: layerCommandCounts.actors,
378:      propCommandCount: layerCommandCounts.props,
379:      debugCommandCount: layerCommandCounts.debug,
380:      publicClutterCommandCount: visibleCommands.filter((command) => command.publicClutterRisk).length,
381:      chunkCoverageRatio: roundMetric(chunkIds.length / Math.max(1, chunkIndex.chunkCount)),
382:    },
383:  };
384:}

386:export function evaluateCityWorldSceneWindowBudget(
387:  window: CityWorldSceneWindow,
388:  budgetOrProfileId: CityWorldSceneWindowBudget | CityWorldSceneWindowBudgetProfileId,
389:  scene?: CityWorldScene,
390:): CityWorldSceneWindowBudgetResult {
391:  const budget = typeof budgetOrProfileId === "string" ? CITY_WORLD_SCENE_WINDOW_BUDGETS[budgetOrProfileId] : budgetOrProfileId;
392:  const blockers: string[] = [];
393:  const { metrics } = window;
394:
395:  requireAtMost(blockers, metrics.commandVisibilityRatio, budget.maxVisibleCommandRatio, "commandVisibilityRatio");
396:  requireAtMost(blockers, metrics.visibleBudgetWeight, budget.maxVisibleBudgetWeight, "visibleBudgetWeight");
397:  requireAtMost(blockers, metrics.publicClutterCommandCount, budget.maxPublicClutterCommands, "publicClutterCommandCount");
398:  requireAtMost(blockers, metrics.debugCommandCount, budget.maxDebugCommands, "debugCommandCount");
399:  if (budget.maxActorCommands !== undefined) requireAtMost(blockers, metrics.actorCommandCount, budget.maxActorCommands, "actorCommandCount");
400:  if (budget.maxPropCommands !== undefined) requireAtMost(blockers, metrics.propCommandCount, budget.maxPropCommands, "propCommandCount");
401:  requireAtLeast(blockers, metrics.terrainCommandCount, budget.minTerrainCommands, "terrainCommandCount");
402:  requireAtLeast(blockers, metrics.roadCommandCount, budget.minRoadCommands, "roadCommandCount");

419:  return {

428:function commandTouchesFrame(index: CityWorldSceneItemIndex, command: CityWorldRenderCommand, frame: CityWorldViewportFrame): boolean {
429:  switch (command.kind) {
430:    case "terrain_tile": {
431:      const item = index.terrainTiles.get(command.sourceId);
432:      return item ? cityWorldPointInsideFrame(item.position, frame) : false;
433:    }
434:    case "road_segment": {
435:      const item = index.roadSegments.get(command.sourceId);
436:      return item ? cityWorldSegmentTouchesFrame(item.from, item.to, frame) : false;
437:    }
438:    case "lot": {
439:      const item = index.lots.get(command.sourceId);
440:      return item ? footprintTouchesFrame(item.position, item.width, item.depth, frame) : false;
441:    }
442:    case "building": {
443:      const item = index.buildings.get(command.sourceId);
444:      return item ? footprintTouchesFrame(item.position, item.width, item.depth, frame) : false;
445:    }
446:    case "prop": {
447:      const item = index.props.get(command.sourceId);
448:      return item ? cityWorldPointInsideFrame(item.position, frame) : false;
449:    }
450:    case "actor": {
451:      const item = index.actors.get(command.sourceId);
452:      return item ? cityWorldPointInsideFrame(item.position, frame) || item.path.some((point) => cityWorldPointInsideFrame(point, frame)) : false;
453:    }
454:    case "place_marker":
455:    case "place_label": {
456:      const item = index.places.get(command.sourceId);
457:      return item ? cityWorldPointInsideFrame(item.anchor, frame) : false;
458:    }
459:    case "pin": {
460:      const item = index.pins.get(command.sourceId);
461:      return item ? cityWorldPointInsideFrame(item.anchor, frame) : false;
462:    }
463:    case "engine_debug_overlay":
464:      return true;
465:  }
466:}

508:function footprintTouchesFrame(center: CityWorldPoint, width: number, depth: number, frame: CityWorldViewportFrame): boolean {
509:  return center.x + width / 2 >= frame.minX &&
510:    center.x - width / 2 <= frame.maxX &&
511:    center.y + depth / 2 >= frame.minY &&
512:    center.y - depth / 2 <= frame.maxY;
513:}

515:function getOrCreateChunk(
516:  chunkMap: Map<string, CityWorldSceneChunk>,
517:  scene: CityWorldScene,
518:  id: string,
519:  point: CityWorldPoint,
520:  chunkSize: number,
521:): CityWorldSceneChunk {
522:  const existing = chunkMap.get(id);
523:  if (existing) return existing;
524:  const minX = scene.bounds.minX + Math.floor((point.x - scene.bounds.minX) / chunkSize) * chunkSize;
525:  const minY = scene.bounds.minY + Math.floor((point.y - scene.bounds.minY) / chunkSize) * chunkSize;
526:  const chunk = {
527:    id,
528:    bounds: {
529:      minX,
530:      maxX: minX + chunkSize,
531:      minY,
532:      maxY: minY + chunkSize,
533:    },
534:    commandIds: [],
535:    layerCommandCounts: emptyLayerCounts(),
536:    budgetWeight: 0,
537:  };
538:  chunkMap.set(id, chunk);
539:  return chunk;
540:}

542:function chunkIdForPoint(scene: CityWorldScene, point: CityWorldPoint, chunkSize: number): string {
543:  const chunkX = Math.floor((point.x - scene.bounds.minX) / chunkSize);
544:  const chunkY = Math.floor((point.y - scene.bounds.minY) / chunkSize);
545:  return `chunk-${chunkX}-${chunkY}`;
546:}

390:function layerSummaries(commands: CityWorldRenderCommand[]): Record<CityWorldRenderLayerId, CityWorldRenderLayerSummary> {
391:  const summaries = Object.fromEntries(CITY_WORLD_RENDER_LAYER_ORDER.map((layerId) => [
392:    layerId,
393:    {
394:      layerId,
395:      commandCount: 0,
396:      budgetWeight: 0,
397:      interactiveCommandCount: 0,
398:      animatedCommandCount: 0,
399:      spriteBackedCommandCount: 0,
400:      publicClutterCommandCount: 0,
401:    },
402:  ])) as Record<CityWorldRenderLayerId, CityWorldRenderLayerSummary>;
403:
404:  for (const command of commands) {
405:    const summary = summaries[command.layerId];
406:    summary.commandCount += 1;
407:    summary.budgetWeight += command.budgetWeight;
408:    if (command.interactive) summary.interactiveCommandCount += 1;
409:    if (command.animated) summary.animatedCommandCount += 1;
410:    if (command.spriteBacked) summary.spriteBackedCommandCount += 1;
411:    if (command.publicClutterRisk) summary.publicClutterCommandCount += 1;
412:  }
413:
414:  return summaries;
415:}

417:function renderCommandMetrics(
418:  commands: CityWorldRenderCommand[],
419:  layers: Record<CityWorldRenderLayerId, CityWorldRenderLayerSummary>,
420:): CityWorldRenderCommandBuffer["metrics"] {

426:    interactiveCommandCount: commands.filter((command) => command.interactive).length,
427:    animatedCommandCount: commands.filter((command) => command.animated).length,
428:    spriteBackedCommandCount: commands.filter((command) => command.spriteBacked).length,
429:    terrainCommandCount: commandCount("terrain"),
430:    roadCommandCount: commandCount("roads"),
431:    lotCommandCount: commandCount("lots"),
432:    buildingCommandCount: commandCount("buildings"),
433:    propCommandCount: commandCount("props"),
434:    actorCommandCount: commandCount("actors"),
435:    markerCommandCount: commandCount("markers"),
436:    labelCommandCount: commandCount("labels"),
437:    debugCommandCount: commandCount("debug"),
438:    orderedLayerCount: unique(commands.map((command) => command.layerId)).length,
439:  };
440:}

199:export function buildCityWorldRenderCommandBuffer(
200:  scene: CityWorldScene,
201:  options: CityWorldRenderCommandBufferOptions = {},
202:): CityWorldRenderCommandBuffer {
203:  const includeLabels = options.includeLabels ?? true;
204:  const includeDebug = options.includeDebug ?? false;
205:  const commands: CityWorldRenderCommand[] = [];
206:
207:  for (const tile of scene.terrainTiles) {
208:    commands.push(renderCommand("terrain", "terrain_tile", tile, 0, 1));
209:  }
210:
211:  for (const road of scene.roadSegments) {
212:    commands.push(renderCommand("roads", "road_segment", road, 0, road.kind === "avenue" ? 3 : 2));
213:  }
214:
215:  for (const lot of scene.lots) {
216:    commands.push(renderCommand("lots", "lot", lot, 0, 2, { spriteBacked: Boolean(lot.spriteKey) }));
217:  }
218:
219:  for (const building of scene.buildings) {
220:    commands.push(renderCommand("buildings", "building", building, footprintZOrder(building), building.detailLevel === "high" ? 5 : 4, { spriteBacked: Boolean(building.spriteKey) }));
221:  }
222:
223:  for (const prop of scene.props) {
224:    commands.push(renderCommand("props", "prop", prop, pointZOrder(prop.position), 1, {
225:      animated: prop.kind === "cloud" || prop.kind === "water_shimmer",
226:      publicClutterRisk: forbiddenPublicPropKinds.has(prop.kind),
227:      spriteBacked: Boolean(prop.spriteKey),
228:    }));
229:  }
230:
231:  for (const actor of scene.actors) {
232:    commands.push(renderCommand("actors", "actor", actor, pointZOrder(actor.position), actor.kind === "clawd" ? 3 : 2, {
233:      animated: actor.kind !== "clawd",
234:      publicClutterRisk: actor.kind === "car" || actor.kind === "walker",
235:      spriteBacked: Boolean(actor.spriteKey),
236:    }));
237:  }
238:
239:  for (const place of scene.places) {
240:    commands.push(renderCommand("markers", "place_marker", place, 0, 2, { interactive: true }));
241:  }
242:
243:  for (const pin of scene.pins) {
244:    commands.push(renderCommand("markers", "pin", pin, 0, 1, { spriteBacked: Boolean(pin.spriteKey) }));
245:  }
246:
247:  if (includeLabels) {
248:    for (const place of scene.places) {
249:      commands.push(renderCommand("labels", "place_label", place, 0, 1));
250:    }
251:  }
252:
253:  if (includeDebug) {
254:    commands.push({
255:      id: `debug:${scene.id}:engine-overlay`,
256:      layerId: "debug",
257:      kind: "engine_debug_overlay",
258:      sourceId: scene.id,
259:      zOrder: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER,
260:      budgetWeight: 1,

35:/**
36: * Parametric scene-generator seam.
37: *
38: * This is the reusable primitive that makes arbitrary locations voxelizable: a
39: * compact, provider-free spec (an elevation/height grid, road seeds, and
40: * land-use zones) is expanded into a fully enriched {@link CityWorldScene} by
41: * running bare positioned primitives through the SAME generator-agnostic
42: * enrichment decorators the hand-authored Eastvale path uses
43: * ({@link withBuildingMetadata}, {@link withLotMetadata}, {@link withRoadMetadata},
44: * {@link withPropMetadata}). Only terrain visual-grammar is computed here,
45: * because the hand-authored terrain grammar is bound to the fixed Eastvale
46: * field predicates; everything downstream of a positioned primitive is shared.
47: *
48: * The spec consumes curated/synthetic input only â€” it never touches provider
49: * geometry.
50: */
51:
52:export type CityWorldZoneKind =
53:  | "residential"
54:  | "commercial"
55:  | "civic"
56:  | "apartments"
57:  | "gym"
58:  | "park"
59:  | "water"
60:  | "plaza"
61:  | "farm_field"
62:  | "plaza_paving"
63:  | "civic_forecourt"
64:  | "dry_wash"
65:  | "meadow"
66:  | "scree"
67:  | "shore_bank"
68:  | "green_common";
69:
70:export type CityWorldZoneSpec = {
71:  id: string;
72:  kind: CityWorldZoneKind;
73:  /** Zone rectangle in tile coordinates (inclusive). */
74:  rect: { minX: number; minY: number; maxX: number; maxY: number };
75:  label?: string;
76:  /** Optional local elevation bump applied to buildings/lots in this zone. */
77:  elevationBoost?: number;
78:  /** Density hint (0..1) controlling how many parcels are packed into the zone. */
79:  density?: number;
80:};
81:

83:  id: string;
84:  kind: CityWorldRoadSegment["kind"];
85:  from: { x: number; y: number };

87:  width?: number;
88:};

90:export type CityWorldParametricSpec = {
91:  id: string;
92:  label: string;
93:  region: { country: string; state: string; county: string; district: string };
94:  /** Grid size in tiles. */
95:  size: { width: number; height: number };
96:  /**
97:   * Optional coarse height grid (row-major, indexed [y][x] in cells of
98:   * `heightGrid.cellSize` tiles). Values are relative elevation 0..1 and shape
99:   * terrain shelf/basin massing. When omitted the generator infers relief from
100:   * zones alone.
101:   */
102:  heightGrid?: { cellSize: number; values: number[][] };
103:  zones: CityWorldZoneSpec[];
104:  roadSeeds: CityWorldRoadSeed[];
105:  /**
106:   * Optional compiler-authored regional palette for generated districts. When
107:   * absent, the legacy kind-keyed template pools and terrain keys are used.
108:   */
109:  regionalPalette?: RegionalPalette;
110:  /**
111:   * Optional generated-county parameter spine. When present, signature
112:   * landmarks are selected from the resolved county parameters instead of
113:   * re-deriving identity from a flat archetype bucket.
114:   */
115:  countyParameters?: CountyGenerationParameters;
116:  /** Optional deterministic seed for parcel jitter. Defaults to 1. */
117:  seed?: number;
118:};

170:export function generateParametricCityWorldScene(spec: CityWorldParametricSpec): CityWorldParametricResult {
171:  const bounds: CityWorldBounds = { minX: 0, minY: 0, maxX: spec.size.width, maxY: spec.size.height };
172:  const rng = mulberry32(spec.seed ?? 1);
173:
174:  const roadSegments = spec.roadSeeds.map((seed) =>
175:    withRoadMetadata({
176:      id: seed.id,
177:      kind: seed.kind,
178:      from: { x: seed.from.x, y: seed.from.y, z: 0 },
179:      to: { x: seed.to.x, y: seed.to.y, z: 0 },
180:      width: seed.width ?? defaultRoadWidth(seed.kind),
181:    }),
182:  );
183:  const elevationModel = createParametricElevationModel(spec, bounds, roadSegments);
184:  const terrainTiles = createParametricTerrain(spec, bounds, elevationModel);
185:  // Roads render at the elevation of the ground they cross (corridor rule
186:  // keeps both endpoints on the same level for grid-aligned seeds).
187:  for (const road of roadSegments) {
188:    road.from.z = elevationModel.tileZ(Math.round(road.from.x), Math.round(road.from.y));
189:    road.to.z = elevationModel.tileZ(Math.round(road.to.x), Math.round(road.to.y));
190:  }
191:
192:  const lots: CityWorldLot[] = [];
193:  const buildings: CityWorldBuilding[] = [];
194:  const places: CityWorldPlace[] = [];
195:  const props: CityWorldProp[] = [];
196:
197:  // Corner stores face the district's central mass.
198:  const boardCenter = { x: (bounds.minX + bounds.maxX) / 2, y: (bounds.minY + bounds.maxY) / 2 };
199:  const appendZoneProps = (zone: CityWorldZoneSpec): void => {
200:    for (const prop of zonePropsForZone(zone, rng, spec, roadSegments)) {
201:      if (prop.kind !== "water_shimmer" && prop.kind !== "boat" && prop.kind !== "dock") {
202:        prop.position.z = elevationModel.tileZ(Math.round(prop.position.x), Math.round(prop.position.y));
203:      }
204:      props.push(prop);
205:    }
206:  };
207:
208:  let placeIndex = 0;
209:  for (const zone of spec.zones) {
210:    const lotKind = ZONE_TO_LOT[zone.kind];
211:    if (!lotKind) {
212:      if (standaloneZonePropsEnabled(zone, spec)) appendZoneProps(zone);
213:      continue;
214:    }
215:    const placeId = `gen-place-${zone.id}`;
216:    // Safety net for arbitrary specs: a parcel that would put its building in
217:    // a road corridor is dropped. Soft zones (park/water) may host embedded
218:    // roads â€” the renderer draws roads over lot ground.
219:    const softZone = zone.kind === "park" || zone.kind === "water";
220:    let parcels = layoutZoneParcels(zone, rng, boardCenter, 0, spec.regionalPalette, spec.countyParameters).filter(
221:      (parcel) => softZone || parcelClearsRoads(parcel, roadSegments),
222:    );
223:    if (parcels.length === 0 && !softZone) {
224:      // A re-gridded zone can land every parcel inside a road corridor and
225:      // silently erase the whole zone (lots, buildings, AND its place).
226:      // Retry once with the grid shifted a quarter cell â€” deterministic, and
227:      // only reached when the primary grid produced nothing.
228:      parcels = layoutZoneParcels(zone, rng, boardCenter, 0.25, spec.regionalPalette, spec.countyParameters).filter((parcel) =>
229:        parcelClearsRoads(parcel, roadSegments),
230:      );
231:    }
232:    if (parcels.length === 0) continue;
233:
234:    for (const parcel of parcels) {
235:      const parcelZ = elevationModel.tileZ(Math.round(parcel.x), Math.round(parcel.y));
236:      lots.push(
237:        withLotMetadata(
238:          {
239:            id: `gen-lot-${zone.id}-${parcel.index}`,
240:            kind: parcel.lotKind ?? lotKind,
241:            label: parcel.spec?.labelOverride ?? zone.label ?? zoneLabel(zone.kind),
242:            position: { x: parcel.x, y: parcel.y, z: parcelZ },
243:            width: parcel.width,
244:            depth: parcel.depth,
245:            placeId,
246:          },
247:          roadSegments,
248:        ),
249:      );
250:
251:      const building = buildingForZone(zone, parcel, placeId, rng, spec.regionalPalette, spec.countyParameters);
252:      if (building) {
253:        building.position.z = parcelZ;
254:        buildings.push(withBuildingMetadata(building));
255:      }
256:    }
257:
258:    places.push({
259:      id: placeId,
260:      label: zone.label ?? zoneLabel(zone.kind),
261:      kind: placeKindForZone(zone.kind),
262:      districtId: spec.region.district,
263:      nodeId: zone.id,
264:      anchor: { x: zoneCenter(zone).x, y: zoneCenter(zone).y, z: elevationModel.tileZ(Math.round(zoneCenter(zone).x), Math.round(zoneCenter(zone).y)) },
265:      hitRadius: zone.kind === "park" ? 3.8 : 2.8,
266:      description: `Generated ${zoneLabel(zone.kind)} zone.`,
267:      activity: 0,
268:      labelPriority: placeIndex < 6 ? 10 - placeIndex : 3,
269:    });
270:    placeIndex += 1;
271:
272:    appendZoneProps(zone);
273:  }
274:
275:  const signatureLandmark = createGeneratedLandmark(spec, elevationModel, roadSegments);
276:  if (signatureLandmark) {
277:    lots.push(signatureLandmark.lot);
278:    buildings.push(signatureLandmark.building);
279:    places.push(signatureLandmark.place);
280:    props.push(...signatureLandmark.props);
281:  }
282:
283:  const scene: CityWorldScene = {
284:    type: "cityWorldScene",
285:    id: spec.id,
286:    sourceSceneId: `parametric-${spec.id}`,
287:    label: spec.label,
288:    region: spec.region,
289:    bounds,
290:    cameraPresets: parametricCameraPresets(
291:      bounds,
292:      spec.zones,
293:      { bounds, terrainTiles, waterTiles: terrainTiles.filter((tile) => tile.kind === "water"), roadSegments, lots, buildings },
294:      spec.countyParameters,
295:    ),
296:    terrainTiles,
297:    roadSegments,
298:    lots,
299:    buildings,
300:    props,
301:    places,
302:    pins: [],
303:    actors: [],
304:    ambient: {
305:      timeOfDay: "midday",
306:      activity: "calm",
307:      traffic: 0,
308:      residents: 0,
309:      clouds: 0,
310:      waterShimmer: spec.zones.some((zone) => zone.kind === "water") ? 0.6 : 0,
311:    },
312:    hudDefaults: {
313:      locationLabel: spec.region.county,
314:      districtLabel: spec.region.district,
315:      // 0.57E parity â€” default the selection to the landmark (like curated
316:      // Eastvale Core), not the first residential zone: selecting a
317:      // many-building home_area place rings every house on first paint.
318:      selectedPlaceId: signatureLandmark?.place.id ?? (places.find((place) => place.kind === "landmark") ?? places[0])?.id ?? "",
319:    },
320:  };
321:
322:  return {
323:    scene,
324:    stats: {
325:      terrainTiles: terrainTiles.length,
326:      roads: roadSegments.length,
327:      lots: lots.length,
328:      buildings: buildings.length,
329:      props: props.length,
330:      zones: spec.zones.length,
331:    },
332:  };
333:}

336:const ROAD_CLEARANCE_MARGIN = 0.35;

338:function parcelClearsRoads(parcel: ParcelLayout, roads: CityWorldRoadSegment[]): boolean {
339:  const halfW = parcel.width / 2;
340:  const halfD = parcel.depth / 2;

1209:function terrainChunkEdgeProfile(
1210:  kind: CityWorldTerrainKind,
1211:  shell: boolean,
1212:  position?: CityWorldPoint,
1213:  draft = false,
1214:): NonNullable<CityWorldVisualGrammar["chunkEdge"]> {
1215:  if (!position) return "none";
1216:  if (draft) return isOnBounds(position, DRAFT_DISTRICT_BOUNDS) ? "hidden_draft_boundary" : "none";
1217:  if (shell) return isOnBounds(position, SHELL_BOUNDS) ? "world_edge" : "none";
1218:  if (kind === "water") return "waterfront_bank_edge";
1219:  if (isNearBounds(position, CITY_BOUNDS, 3)) return "world_edge";
1220:  if (kind === "park" && position.x >= 14 && position.x <= 21 && position.y >= 17 && position.y <= 23) {
1221:    return position.x === 14 || position.x === 21 || position.y === 17 || position.y === 23 ? "park_basin_edge" : "none";
1222:  }
1223:  if (kind === "plaza" || kind === "sidewalk") return "parcel_cluster_edge";
1224:  if (kind === "grass" && (isCivicShelfEdge(position) || isCommercialShelfEdge(position) || isResidentialShelfEdge(position))) return "parcel_cluster_edge";
1225:
1226:  return "none";
1227:}
1228:
1229:function terrainChunkMassingProfile(
1230:  kind: CityWorldTerrainKind,
1231:  shell: boolean,
1232:  position?: CityWorldPoint,
1233:  draft = false,
1234:): NonNullable<CityWorldVisualGrammar["terrainChunkMassing"]> {
1235:  if (!position) return "none";
1236:  if (draft) return isOnBounds(position, DRAFT_DISTRICT_BOUNDS) ? "hidden_draft_mass" : "none";
1237:  if (shell) return isOnBounds(position, SHELL_BOUNDS) ? "shell_boundary_mass" : "none";
1238:  if (kind === "water") return "waterfront_bank_cut_mass";
1239:  if (isNearBounds(position, CITY_BOUNDS, 3)) return "outer_world_edge_mass";
1240:  if (kind === "park" && position.x >= 14 && position.x <= 21 && position.y >= 17 && position.y <= 23) {
1241:    return "park_basin_cut_mass";
1242:  }
1243:  if (kind === "plaza" || kind === "sidewalk") return "commercial_slab_mass";
1244:  if (inCivicMassingField(position)) return "civic_plinth_mass";
1245:  if (inResidentialMassingField(position)) return "residential_shelf_mass";
1246:  if (inCommercialMassingField(position)) return "commercial_slab_mass";
1247:  return "none";
1248:}

1250:function isOnBounds(position: CityWorldPoint, bounds: CityWorldBounds) {
1251:  return position.x === bounds.minX || position.x === bounds.maxX || position.y === bounds.minY || position.y === bounds.maxY;
1252:}
1253:
1254:function isNearBounds(position: CityWorldPoint, bounds: CityWorldBounds, distance: number) {
1255:  return (
1256:    position.x <= bounds.minX + distance ||
1257:    position.x >= bounds.maxX - distance ||
1258:    position.y <= bounds.minY + distance ||
1259:    position.y >= bounds.maxY - distance
1260:  );
1261:}
1262:
1263:function inCivicMassingField(position: CityWorldPoint) {
1264:  return position.x >= 16 && position.x <= 27 && position.y >= 6 && position.y <= 17;
1265:}
1266:
1267:function inCommercialMassingField(position: CityWorldPoint) {
1268:  return (
1269:    (position.x >= 23 && position.x <= 37 && position.y >= 9 && position.y <= 22) ||
1270:    (position.x >= 26 && position.x <= 35 && position.y >= 18 && position.y <= 25)
1271:  );
1272:}
1273:
1274:function inResidentialMassingField(position: CityWorldPoint) {
1275:  return (
1276:    (position.x >= 2 && position.x <= 22 && position.y >= 2 && position.y <= 17) ||
1277:    (position.x >= 14 && position.x <= 31 && position.y >= 3 && position.y <= 15) ||
1278:    (position.x >= 6 && position.x <= 26 && position.y >= 11 && position.y <= 20) ||
1279:    (position.x >= 9 && position.x <= 18 && position.y >= 18 && position.y <= 24) ||
1280:    (position.x >= 22 && position.x <= 29 && position.y >= 21 && position.y <= 26)
1281:  );
1282:}
1283:
1284:function isCivicShelfEdge(position: CityWorldPoint) {
1285:  return (
1286:    ((position.x === 16 || position.x === 27) && position.y >= 6 && position.y <= 17) ||
1287:    ((position.y === 6 || position.y === 17) && position.x >= 16 && position.x <= 27) ||
1288:    (position.x === 21 && position.y >= 7 && position.y <= 16) ||
1289:    (position.y === 12 && position.x >= 17 && position.x <= 26)
1290:  );
1291:}
1292:
1293:function isCommercialShelfEdge(position: CityWorldPoint) {
1294:  return (
1295:    ((position.x === 23 || position.x === 37) && position.y >= 9 && position.y <= 22) ||
1296:    ((position.y === 9 || position.y === 22) && position.x >= 23 && position.x <= 37) ||
1297:    ((position.x === 26 || position.x === 35) && position.y >= 18 && position.y <= 25) ||
1298:    ((position.y === 18 || position.y === 25) && position.x >= 26 && position.x <= 35) ||
1299:    (position.x === 31 && position.y >= 10 && position.y <= 22) ||
1300:    (position.y === 15 && position.x >= 24 && position.x <= 36)
1301:  );
1302:}
1303:
1304:function isResidentialShelfEdge(position: CityWorldPoint) {
1305:  return (
1306:    ((position.x === 2 || position.x === 22) && position.y >= 2 && position.y <= 17) ||
1307:    ((position.y === 2 || position.y === 17) && position.x >= 2 && position.x <= 22) ||
1308:    ((position.x === 14 || position.x === 31) && position.y >= 3 && position.y <= 15) ||
1309:    ((position.y === 3 || position.y === 15) && position.x >= 14 && position.x <= 31) ||
1310:    ((position.x === 6 || position.x === 26) && position.y >= 11 && position.y <= 20) ||
1311:    ((position.y === 11 || position.y === 20) && position.x >= 6 && position.x <= 26) ||
1312:    ((position.x === 9 || position.x === 18) && position.y >= 18 && position.y <= 24) ||
1313:    ((position.y === 18 || position.y === 24) && position.x >= 9 && position.x <= 18) ||
1314:    ((position.x === 22 || position.x === 29) && position.y >= 21 && position.y <= 26) ||
1315:    ((position.y === 21 || position.y === 26) && position.x >= 22 && position.x <= 29) ||
1316:    (position.x === 11 && position.y >= 3 && position.y <= 17) ||
1317:    (position.y === 9 && position.x >= 3 && position.x <= 22) ||
1318:    (position.x === 21 && position.y >= 4 && position.y <= 15) ||
1319:    (position.y === 13 && position.x >= 14 && position.x <= 31) ||
1320:    (position.x === 17 && position.y >= 11 && position.y <= 20) ||
1321:    (position.y === 16 && position.x >= 6 && position.x <= 26)
1322:  );

1324:
1325:// ---- Unified ground contact grammar (0.52E Diorama Engine) -----------------
1326:// The compiler is the single source of truth for ground contact treatment.
1327:// Tone (public/draft/shell), road/lot contact profiles, curb-cut edges, and
1328:// terrain material seams are authored here as typed metadata; the renderer
1329:// consumes them uniformly and never re-derives them from ids or kinds at
1330:// draw time.
1331:
1332:function cityWorldGroundTone(id: string): CityWorldGroundTone {
1333:  if (id.startsWith("draft-")) return "draft";
1334:  if (id.startsWith("shell-")) return "shell";
1335:  return "public";
1336:}
1337:
1338:const CITY_WORLD_TILE_NEIGHBORS: ReadonlyArray<readonly [CityWorldTileEdge, number, number]> = [
1339:  ["north", 0, -1],
1340:  ["east", 1, 0],
1341:  ["south", 0, 1],
1342:  ["west", -1, 0],
1343:];
1344:
1345:// The higher-priority material of a boundary owns the seam, so every material
1346:// joint is authored exactly once instead of being double-drawn by both tiles.
1347:const TERRAIN_SEAM_PRIORITY: Record<CityWorldTerrainKind, number> = {
1348:  water: 5,
1349:  plaza: 4,
1350:  sidewalk: 3,
1351:  park: 2,
1352:  grass: 1,
1353:};
1354:
1355:export function withCityWorldTerrainContactMetadata(tiles: CityWorldTerrainTile[], tone: CityWorldGroundTone): CityWorldTerrainTile[] {
1356:  const kindByCoordinate = new Map<string, CityWorldTerrainKind>();
1357:  for (const tile of tiles) {
1358:    kindByCoordinate.set(`${tile.position.x},${tile.position.y}`, tile.kind);
1359:  }
1360:
1361:  return tiles.map((tile) => {
1362:    const edgeSides: CityWorldTileEdge[] = [];
1363:    const waterEdgeSides: CityWorldTileEdge[] = [];
1364:
1365:    for (const [side, dx, dy] of CITY_WORLD_TILE_NEIGHBORS) {
1366:      const neighborKind = kindByCoordinate.get(`${tile.position.x + dx},${tile.position.y + dy}`);
1367:      if (!neighborKind || neighborKind === tile.kind) continue;
1368:      if ((tile.kind === "water") !== (neighborKind === "water")) {
1369:        // The land tile owns the bank strand; the water side already carries
1370:        // waterfront bank massing from the elevation grammar.
1371:        if (tile.kind !== "water") waterEdgeSides.push(side);
1372:        continue;
1373:      }
1374:      if (TERRAIN_SEAM_PRIORITY[tile.kind] > TERRAIN_SEAM_PRIORITY[neighborKind]) {
1375:        edgeSides.push(side);
1376:      }
1377:    }
1378:
1379:    const terrainContact: CityWorldTerrainContactGrammar = {
1380:      tone,
1381:      contactShadow: tone === "public" && (tile.kind === "plaza" || tile.kind === "sidewalk") && edgeSides.length > 0,
1382:      ...(edgeSides.length > 0 ? { edgeSides } : {}),
1383:      ...(waterEdgeSides.length > 0 ? { waterEdgeSides } : {}),
1384:    };
1385:
1386:    return {
1387:      ...tile,
1388:      visualGrammar: { ...(tile.visualGrammar ?? { contactProfile: "soft_ground_shadow" as const }), terrainContact },
1389:    };
1390:  });
1391:}
1392:
1393:// Curb cuts only make sense for lots that actually front a road; anything
1394:// farther than this stays honest and does not fake a driveway join.
1395:const CURB_CUT_MAX_ROAD_DISTANCE = 7;
1396:
1397:function lotCurbCutEdge(lot: CityWorldLot, roads: CityWorldRoadSegment[]): CityWorldTileEdge | undefined {
1398:  if (lot.kind === "waterfront") return undefined;
1399:  let best: { distance: number; edge: CityWorldTileEdge } | undefined;
1400:
1401:  for (const road of roads) {
1402:    if (road.kind === "crosswalk") continue;
1403:    const nearest = nearestPointOnCitySegment(lot.position, road.from, road.to);
1404:    const dx = nearest.x - lot.position.x;
1405:    const dy = nearest.y - lot.position.y;
1406:    const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
1407:    if (distance > CURB_CUT_MAX_ROAD_DISTANCE) continue;
1408:    // Normalize by the footprint so wide lots prefer their long frontage.
1409:    const edge: CityWorldTileEdge =
1410:      Math.abs(dx) / Math.max(lot.width, 0.001) >= Math.abs(dy) / Math.max(lot.depth, 0.001)
1411:        ? dx >= 0
1412:          ? "east"
1413:          : "west"
1414:        : dy >= 0
1415:          ? "south"
1416:          : "north";
1417:    if (!best || distance < best.distance) best = { distance, edge };
1418:  }
1419:
1420:  return best?.edge;
1421:}
1422:
1423:function nearestPointOnCitySegment(point: CityWorldPoint, from: CityWorldPoint, to: CityWorldPoint): CityWorldPoint {
1424:  const dx = to.x - from.x;
1425:  const dy = to.y - from.y;
1426:  const lengthSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy;
1427:  if (lengthSquared <= 0) return { x: from.x, y: from.y, z: 0 };
1428:  const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((point.x - from.x) * dx + (point.y - from.y) * dy) / lengthSquared));
1429:  return { x: from.x + dx * t, y: from.y + dy * t, z: 0 };
1430:}
1431:
1432:function roadVisualGrammar(road: CityWorldRoadSegment, tone: CityWorldGroundTone): CityWorldVisualGrammar {
1433:  const roadContact: CityWorldRoadContactGrammar = {
1434:    profile: road.kind === "crosswalk" ? "painted" : road.kind === "driveway" ? "apron" : "embedded",
1435:    tone,
1436:    laneMarking:
1437:      road.kind === "avenue" ? "avenue_dash" : road.kind === "street" ? "street_dash" : road.kind === "driveway" ? "apron_dash" : "none",
1438:  };
1439:  if (road.kind === "crosswalk") return { roadProfile: "paver_crosswalk", contactProfile: "curb_shadow", roadContact };
1440:  if (road.kind === "driveway") return { roadProfile: "driveway_cut", contactProfile: "curb_shadow", roadContact };
1441:  return { roadProfile: "embedded_asphalt_slab", contactProfile: "curb_shadow", roadContact };
1442:}
1443:
1444:function lotContactGrammar(lot: CityWorldLot, tone: CityWorldGroundTone, curbCutEdge: CityWorldTileEdge | undefined): CityWorldLotContactGrammar {
1445:  const profile =
1446:    lot.kind === "waterfront" ? "shore" : lot.kind === "park" ? "green" : lot.kind === "shop" || lot.kind === "gym" ? "apron" : "foundation";
1447:  return {
1448:    profile,
1449:    tone,
1450:    ...(curbCutEdge && profile !== "shore" ? { curbCutEdge } : {}),
1451:  };
1452:}
1453:
1454:function lotVisualGrammar(lot: CityWorldLot, lotContact: CityWorldLotContactGrammar): CityWorldVisualGrammar {
1455:  const parcelComposition = parcelCompositionProfile(lot);
1456:  const parcelElevation = parcelElevationProfile(lot);
1457:  if (lot.kind === "home") return { lotProfile: lot.id.startsWith("lot-home-") ? "residential_yard_grid" : "home_parcel_pad", parcelComposition, parcelElevation, contactProfile: "parcel_pad_shadow", lotContact };
1458:  if (lot.kind === "shop" || lot.kind === "gym") return { lotProfile: "commercial_forecourt", parcelComposition, parcelElevation, contactProfile: "parcel_pad_shadow", lotContact };
1459:  if (lot.kind === "civic") return { lotProfile: lot.placeId === "place-eastvale-core" ? "landmark_civic_ground" : "civic_plaza_pad", parcelComposition, parcelElevation, contactProfile: "landmark_base_shadow", lotContact };
1460:  if (lot.kind === "apartments") return { lotProfile: "apartment_court", parcelComposition, parcelElevation, contactProfile: "parcel_pad_shadow", lotContact };
1461:  if (lot.kind === "waterfront") return { lotProfile: "waterfront_edge", parcelComposition, parcelElevation, contactProfile: "soft_ground_shadow", lotContact };
1462:  return { lotProfile: "park_soft_edge", parcelComposition, parcelElevation, contactProfile: "soft_ground_shadow", lotContact };
1463:}
1464:
1465:function parcelCompositionProfile(lot: CityWorldLot): NonNullable<CityWorldVisualGrammar["parcelComposition"]> {
1466:  if (lot.id.startsWith("draft-lot-")) return "hidden_draft_anchor_pad";
1467:  if (lot.kind === "home") return "home_yard_grid";
1468:  if (lot.kind === "shop" || lot.kind === "gym") return "commercial_apron";
1469:  if (lot.kind === "civic") return "civic_landmark_plinth";
1470:  if (lot.kind === "apartments") return "apartment_court_grid";
1471:  if (lot.kind === "waterfront") return "waterfront_bank";
1472:  return "park_path_basin";
1473:}

1475:function parcelElevationProfile(lot: CityWorldLot): NonNullable<CityWorldVisualGrammar["parcelElevation"]> {

2224:function addVegetationSpec(
2225:  specs: ZonePropSpec[],
2226:  context: PropPlacementContext,
2227:  kind: "tree" | "bush",
2228:  rawPoint: CityWorldPoint,
2229:  variant = specs.length,

2236:  specs.push({ kind, point, variant });
2237:  return true;

2240:function roadFrontagesForZone(
2241:  zone: CityWorldZoneSpec,
2242:  roads: CityWorldRoadSegment[],
2243:): Array<{ axis: "x" | "y"; start: number; end: number; offset: number; roadId: string }> {
2244:  const frontages: Array<{ axis: "x" | "y"; start: number; end: number; offset: number; roadId: string }> = [];
2245:  const center = zoneCenter(zone);
2246:  for (const road of roads) {
2247:    if (road.kind === "crosswalk") continue;
2248:    const horizontal = road.from.y === road.to.y;
2249:    const vertical = road.from.x === road.to.x;
2250:    const half = road.width / 2 + ROAD_CLEARANCE_MARGIN + 0.72;
2251:    if (horizontal) {
2252:      const roadY = road.from.y;
2253:      const roadMinX = Math.min(road.from.x, road.to.x);
2254:      const roadMaxX = Math.max(road.from.x, road.to.x);
2255:      if (roadY < zone.rect.minY - 2.6 || roadY > zone.rect.maxY + 2.6) continue;
2256:      const start = Math.max(zone.rect.minX + 1, roadMinX + 1);
2257:      const end = Math.min(zone.rect.maxX - 1, roadMaxX - 1);
2258:      if (end - start < 2.2) continue;
2259:      frontages.push({
2260:        axis: "x",
2261:        start,
2262:        end,
2263:        offset: cityWorldClamp(roadY <= center.y ? roadY + half : roadY - half, zone.rect.minY + 0.85, zone.rect.maxY - 0.85),
2264:        roadId: road.id,
2265:      });
2266:    } else if (vertical) {
2267:      const roadX = road.from.x;
2268:      const roadMinY = Math.min(road.from.y, road.to.y);
2269:      const roadMaxY = Math.max(road.from.y, road.to.y);
2270:      if (roadX < zone.rect.minX - 2.6 || roadX > zone.rect.maxX + 2.6) continue;
2271:      const start = Math.max(zone.rect.minY + 1, roadMinY + 1);
2272:      const end = Math.min(zone.rect.maxY - 1, roadMaxY - 1);
2273:      if (end - start < 2.2) continue;
2274:      frontages.push({
2275:        axis: "y",
2276:        start,
2277:        end,
2278:        offset: cityWorldClamp(roadX <= center.x ? roadX + half : roadX - half, zone.rect.minX + 0.85, zone.rect.maxX - 0.85),
2279:        roadId: road.id,
2280:      });
2281:    }
2282:  }
2283:  return frontages.sort((a, b) => a.roadId.localeCompare(b.roadId));
2284:}

2336:function zonePoint(zone: CityWorldZoneSpec, fx: number, fy: number): CityWorldPoint {
2337:  return {
2338:    x: zone.rect.minX + (zone.rect.maxX - zone.rect.minX) * fx,

2344:function pointClearsRoads(point: CityWorldPoint, roads: CityWorldRoadSegment[]): boolean {
2345:  for (const road of roads) {
2346:    if (road.kind === "crosswalk") continue;
2347:    const halfCorridor = road.width / 2 + ROAD_CLEARANCE_MARGIN;
2348:    const minX = Math.min(road.from.x, road.to.x) - halfCorridor;
2349:    const maxX = Math.max(road.from.x, road.to.x) + halfCorridor;
2350:    const minY = Math.min(road.from.y, road.to.y) - halfCorridor;
2351:    const maxY = Math.max(road.from.y, road.to.y) + halfCorridor;
2352:    if (point.x >= minX && point.x <= maxX && point.y >= minY && point.y <= maxY) return false;
2353:  }
2354:  return true;
2355:}
2356:
2357:function pointInsideGeneratedBounds(point: CityWorldPoint, spec: CityWorldParametricSpec): boolean {
2358:  return point.x >= 0 && point.x <= spec.size.width && point.y >= 0 && point.y <= spec.size.height;
2359:}

728:function noLabelGroupSeparationScore(buildings: CityWorldBuilding[], groups: string[]): number {
729:  if (groups.length < 2) return 1;
730:  const centers = groups
731:    .map((group) => familyCenter(buildings.filter((building) => building.id.includes(group))))
732:    .filter((center): center is CityWorldPoint => Boolean(center));
733:  if (centers.length < groups.length) return 0;
734:
735:  let minDistance = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
736:  for (let index = 0; index < centers.length; index += 1) {
737:    for (let next = index + 1; next < centers.length; next += 1) {
738:      const currentCenter = centers[index];
739:      const nextCenter = centers[next];
740:      if (!currentCenter || !nextCenter) continue;
741:      minDistance = Math.min(minDistance, cityWorldPointDistance(currentCenter, nextCenter));
742:    }
743:  }
744:
745:  return roundMetric(cityWorldClamp(minDistance / 6, 0, 1));
746:}

748:function familyCenter(buildings: CityWorldBuilding[]): CityWorldPoint | null {
749:  if (buildings.length === 0) return null;
750:  const center = buildings.reduce(
751:    (sum, building) => ({
752:      x: sum.x + building.position.x,
753:      y: sum.y + building.position.y,
754:      z: sum.z + building.position.z,
755:    }),
756:    { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 },
757:  );
758:  return {
759:    x: center.x / buildings.length,
760:    y: center.y / buildings.length,
761:    z: center.z / buildings.length,
762:  };
763:}

490:function terrainVariantForZone(zone: CityWorldZoneSpec | undefined, x: number, y: number): number {
491:  if (!zone) return (x * 17 + y * 11) % 5;
492:  const localX = x - zone.rect.minX;
493:  const localY = y - zone.rect.minY;
494:  if (zone.kind === "farm_field") return localY % 2 === 0 ? 0 : 4;
495:  if (zone.kind === "dry_wash") return (Math.floor((localX + localY * 2) / 3) + zone.id.length) % 2 === 0 ? 1 : 3;
496:  if (zone.kind === "scree") return Math.abs(localX * 2 + localY * 3) % 5;
497:  if (zone.kind === "shore_bank") return localY % 3 === 0 ? 0 : localX % 2 === 0 ? 2 : 4;
498:  if (zone.kind === "plaza_paving" || zone.kind === "civic_forecourt") return (localX + localY) % 2 === 0 ? 0 : 2;
499:  if (zone.kind === "meadow" || zone.kind === "green_common") return Math.abs(localX * 3 + localY * 2) % 5;
500:  return (x * 17 + y * 11) % 5;
501:}

2635:// ---- Terrain relief (0.74F) -------------------------------------------------
2636:// Continuous heightGrid relief quantized to BLOCK granularity: the road grid
2637:// partitions the board into blocks; every tile in a block (and its lots,
2638:// buildings, props, and place anchors) shares one z level, so streets and
2639:// parcels stay flat while the district steps up plateaus. Water and its
2640:// one-tile shore ring force z = 0; road corridors take the LOWER of the
2641:// blocks they border so asphalt never climbs a cliff.
2642:const ELEVATION_Z_LEVELS = [0, 0.5, 1] as const;
2643:
2644:type ParametricElevationModel = {
2645:  tileZ: (x: number, y: number) => number;
2646:};
2647:
2648:function reliefAtBilinear(spec: CityWorldParametricSpec, x: number, y: number): number {
2649:  const grid = spec.heightGrid;
2650:  if (!grid || grid.values.length === 0) return 0;
2651:  const rows = grid.values.length;
2652:  const cols = Math.max(...grid.values.map((row) => row.length), 1);
2653:  const sample = (gx: number, gy: number) => clamp01(grid.values[Math.min(rows - 1, Math.max(0, gy))]?.[Math.min(cols - 1, Math.max(0, gx))] ?? 0);
2654:  // Grid values sample cell centers.
2655:  const fx = x / grid.cellSize - 0.5;
2656:  const fy = y / grid.cellSize - 0.5;
2657:  const x0 = Math.floor(fx);
2658:  const y0 = Math.floor(fy);
2659:  const tx = clamp01(fx - x0);
2660:  const ty = clamp01(fy - y0);
2661:  const top = sample(x0, y0) * (1 - tx) + sample(x0 + 1, y0) * tx;
2662:  const bottom = sample(x0, y0 + 1) * (1 - tx) + sample(x0 + 1, y0 + 1) * tx;
2663:  return top * (1 - ty) + bottom * ty;
2664:}
2665:
2666:function quantizeElevation(value: number): number {
2667:  if (value < 0.45) return ELEVATION_Z_LEVELS[0];
2668:  if (value < 0.7) return ELEVATION_Z_LEVELS[1];
2669:  return ELEVATION_Z_LEVELS[2];
2670:}
2671:
2672:function createParametricElevationModel(
2673:  spec: CityWorldParametricSpec,
2674:  bounds: CityWorldBounds,

2734:function tileElevationGrammar(model: ParametricElevationModel, x: number, y: number): CityWorldTileElevationGrammar | undefined {
2735:  const z = model.tileZ(x, y);
2736:  const neighbors: Array<{ side: CityWorldTileEdge; z: number }> = [
2737:    { side: "north", z: model.tileZ(x, y - 1) },
2738:    { side: "east", z: model.tileZ(x + 1, y) },
2739:    { side: "south", z: model.tileZ(x, y + 1) },
2740:    { side: "west", z: model.tileZ(x - 1, y) },
2741:  ];
2742:  const dropSides = neighbors.filter((neighbor) => neighbor.z < z).map((neighbor) => neighbor.side);
2743:  if (z === 0 && dropSides.length === 0) return undefined;
2744:  const dropDepth = dropSides.length > 0 ? z - Math.min(...neighbors.filter((n) => n.z < z).map((n) => n.z)) : 0;
2745:  return { z, dropSides, dropDepth };
2746:}

2748:function reliefAt(spec: CityWorldParametricSpec, x: number, y: number): number {
2749:  const grid = spec.heightGrid;
2750:  if (!grid || grid.values.length === 0) return 0;
2751:  const gy = Math.min(grid.values.length - 1, Math.floor(y / grid.cellSize));
2752:  const row = grid.values[gy] ?? [];
2753:  const gx = Math.min(row.length - 1, Math.floor(x / grid.cellSize));
2754:  return clamp01(row[gx] ?? 0);
2755:}

6892:function animateTargets(targets: AnimatedTarget[], delta: number) {
6893:  const elapsed = performance.now() / 1000;
6894:  for (const item of targets) {
6895:    if (item.path.length > 1) {
6896:      const ratio = (elapsed * item.speed + item.phase) % 1;
6897:      const position = pointOnPath(item.path, ratio);
6898:      const point = project(position);
6899:      item.target.position.set(point.x - item.origin.x, point.y - item.origin.y);
6900:    }
6901:
6902:    if (item.kind === "water") {
6903:      item.target.alpha = item.baseAlpha + Math.sin(elapsed * 2.2 + item.phase * 8) * 0.16;
6904:    } else if (item.kind === "cloud") {
6905:      item.target.x += delta * item.speed * 8;
6906:      item.target.alpha = item.baseAlpha + Math.sin(elapsed + item.phase * 4) * 0.06;
6907:    } else if (item.kind === "walker") {
6908:      item.target.y += Math.sin(elapsed * 4 + item.phase * 5) * 0.05;
6909:    } else if (item.kind === "pulse") {
6910:      item.target.alpha = item.baseAlpha + Math.sin(elapsed * 2 + item.phase * 4) * 0.05;
6911:    }
6912:  }
6913:}
6914:
6915:function pointOnPath(path: CityWorldPoint[], ratio: number): CityWorldPoint {
6916:  if (path.length === 0) return { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 };
6917:  if (path.length === 1) return path[0] ?? { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 };
6918:
6919:  const scaled = ratio * path.length;
6920:  const index = Math.floor(scaled) % path.length;
6921:  const nextIndex = (index + 1) % path.length;
6922:  const local = scaled - Math.floor(scaled);
6923:  const start = path[index] ?? path[0] ?? { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 };
6924:  const end = path[nextIndex] ?? start;
6925:  return {
6926:    x: start.x + (end.x - start.x) * local,
6927:    y: start.y + (end.y - start.y) * local,
6928:    z: start.z + (end.z - start.z) * local,
6929:  };
6930:}

6933:  return projectCityWorldPoint(point);
6934:}

docs\BUILD_LOG.md:6507:Created `docs/VOXEL_WORLD_BRAIN.md` as the authoritative renderer reset plan for a full-screen Eastvale voxel city map, created `docs/issues/E7.0-city-world-renderer.md`, and updated quest/decision docs so the next implementation pass replaces the card/panel map UI instead of polishing it.
docs\BUILD_LOG.md:6516:Implement E7.0 from `docs/VOXEL_WORLD_BRAIN.md`: full-viewport Pixi canvas, typed `CityWorldScene`, layered city renderer, small HUD overlays, and no old dashboard/card/report UI.
docs\BUILD_LOG.md:6524:Added the typed `CityWorldScene` contract and compiler, switched the root preview and widget to `CityWorldView`, built the full-viewport Pixi `CityWorldRenderer`, and parked the old card/panel renderer path as fallback/reference only. The default app now opens into an Eastvale city map with small HUD overlays, local stickers, local notes, drag, wheel zoom, pinch zoom, hover, place click, labels, pins, cars, walkers, water, and Clawd.
docs\BUILD_LOG.md:6530:`pnpm test:core`, `pnpm typecheck:starter`, `pnpm --dir apps/widget typecheck`, `pnpm build:web`, `pnpm --dir apps/widget build`, and `pnpm build:server` passed. Browser QA on `http://localhost:8787/preview` verified one full-screen canvas, nonblank desktop and mobile screenshots, no old report/flow/card UI classes mounted, no visible campaign/report/signal/risk/tactical/board language, drag camera movement, wheel and pinch zoom, clicks on Eastvale Core, Gym, Community Park, and Apartments, sticker drop, and no mobile horizontal overflow.
docs\BUILD_LOG.md:6541:Added atlas-ready metadata to `CityWorldScene` render objects, including terrain, roads, lots, buildings, props, actors, and pins. Enriched the Eastvale authored scene with denser props, shrubs, benches, parked cars, extra water shimmer, additional streetlights, and more cars/walkers. Reworked the Pixi renderer with stronger terrain variation, road curbs/lane details/crosswalks, lot details, category-specific building art, richer props, clearer cars/walkers, sorted prop/actor depth, and proper destruction of old Pixi children during redraw. Kept the default UI as a full-screen city map with only small React HUD overlays.
docs\BUILD_LOG.md:6595:The next best move is E8.1 if the priority is V1 USA coverage and backend scale. E7.2 remains the visual-quality lane when the next priority is sprite/atlas fidelity. Neither path should bring back the old dashboard/card/campaign framing.
docs\BUILD_LOG.md:6766:The speedup path is not more generic parallel work. Atlas should move through small, owned slices: E8.6 as the primary county-question/tool lane, E8.5 only if review hardening is blocked, and a separate integration/QA pass. E7.4 is already complete locally, so the visual lane should stay idle until a fresh visual issue exists. No app code, renderer behavior, MCP contracts, provider access, auth, Stripe, persistence, or UI shell changes were made.
docs\BUILD_LOG.md:6801:Ignored local `.codex/` QA screenshots so they do not keep polluting `git status`. Expanded Hosted Clawd Beta contracts in `docs/DATABASE_SCHEMA_BETA.md`, rewrote `docs/PRICING_MODEL.md` with Alpha/Beta payment boundaries, added `docs/issues/E9.0-hosted-clawd-beta-contracts.md`, and tightened future Hosted Clawd tool contracts in `docs/TOOL_CONTRACTS.md`. No persistence, auth, Stripe, evidence, XP, or automation code was added.

docs\DECISIONS.md:1664:E6.6 parks the partial Quest Preview slice and makes the visible Alpha experience a geo-grounded city/world map. `VoxelScene` now carries optional `VoxelWorld` data for country/state/county/district/place hierarchy, known places, ambient activity, session-only stickers, and session-only notes. Campaign and Scout tools remain available, but the default UI opens on the map.
docs\DECISIONS.md:1668:The current card/panel voxel UI should not be iterated further. E7.0 will replace the visible map UI with a full-screen Pixi `CityWorldRenderer` driven by typed `CityWorldScene` data. React is limited to tiny HUD overlays. Lottie is limited to optional UI-only animation, Rive is deferred for future Clawd state-machine animation, and Three.js remains out of scope.
docs\DECISIONS.md:1672:E7.1 improves the city map through code-generated Pixi art while adding atlas-ready metadata to `CityWorldScene`. This keeps the Alpha shippable without new dependencies, but gives each building, prop, actor, and terrain object stable keys for future tile and sprite atlas replacement. Pixi remains responsible for map objects and animation; Lottie stays UI-only, Rive stays deferred for Clawd, and no dashboard/card shell returns.

8:// 0.74F widget performance gate. Uses the __ATLAS_QA__.perf probe to prove
9:// the renderer's perf architecture holds:
10://   1. Hover emphasizes via the focus overlay ONLY â€” sceneRebuilds must not
11://      move while overlayRedraws does.
12://   2. Render-on-demand: once ambient animation settles, the rAF loop parks
13://      and renderedFrames stops growing (near-zero idle GPU cost).
14://   3. A streaming-window rebuild stays under the latency ceiling.
15://   4. A small pan is transform-only (zero rebuilds).

18:  constructor(url) { this.url = url; this.id = 0; this.pending = new Map(); this.events = []; this.socket = null; }
19:  async connect() {
20:    if (typeof WebSocket !== "function") throw new Error("Node runtime with global WebSocket required.");
21:    this.socket = new WebSocket(this.url);
22:    this.socket.addEventListener("message", (e) => this.handle(e.data));

1972:function propZoneRng(spec: CityWorldParametricSpec, zone: CityWorldZoneSpec): () => number {

25:   overlay Graphics. Proven live: pointerover leaves `sceneRebuilds` frozen.
26:4. **Render-on-demand**: `app.stop()` + component-owned rAF loop that renders
27:   only when dirty or animating (ambient capped ~30fps via wall-clock â€” rAF
28:   timestamps are virtualized in headless environments), then PARKS at 0fps.
29:   The focus pulse freezes 4s after a focus change so the permanent default
30:   selection can't pin the loop. ResizeObserver replaces ticker-driven resize.
31:5. **Merged Graphics**: terrain/lots merge into depth-band Graphics
32:   (`floor((x+y)/4)`, order-safe by band partition); the road network renders
33:   as 11 pass Graphics; pads/cast shadows fold to one Graphics each.

26:## Gate Semantics
27:
28:- Preflights `GET <base>/emulator` before launching Chrome.
29:- Launches Chrome once, then opens one CDP target per county and viewport.
30:- Waits for parent `window.__ATLAS_EMULATOR__.state === "delivered"` and fails on emulator `error`.
31:- Reads inner widget QA through `window.__ATLAS_EMULATOR__.qa()`.
32:- Drives two 10-step big pans on the inner iframe canvas using the inner window's `PointerEvent`.
33:- Fails a cell when `graphicsCount() > 1600`.
34:- Fails rebuild latency only when a pan actually triggers a rebuild and `min(lastRebuildMs samples) > 350`.
35:- Records `rebuildMs: null` when no rebuild fires.
36:- Runs the hover-does-not-rebuild parity check once on `riverside-ca` desktop.
37:- Reports, but does not fail, generated draft payloads above `900000` chars.
38:- Writes JSON to `artifacts/emulator/perf-report.json` when executed.

3322:function drawHomeRoofAccent(layer: Container, geometry: BuildingGeometry, building: CityWorldBuilding, flip: number, variant: number) {
3323:  const roofShape = building.roofShape ?? "flat";
3324:  if (roofShape !== "gable" && roofShape !== "hip") return;
3325:  const { top, footprintWidth, footprintDepth, roofColor, bodyColor } = geometry;
3326:
3327:  const ridge = new Graphics()
3328:    .moveTo(top.x - flip * footprintWidth * 0.22, top.y - footprintDepth * 0.08)
3329:    .lineTo(top.x + flip * footprintWidth * 0.18, top.y + footprintDepth * 0.08);
3330:  ridge.stroke({ color: shadeColor(roofColor, -34), alpha: 0.3, width: 1.1, cap: "round" });
3331:  layer.addChild(ridge);
3332:
3333:  if (variant % 3 === 0) {
3334:    const cx = top.x + flip * footprintWidth * 0.16;

3337:      .rect(cx - 1.2, cy - 5, 2.4, 5)
3338:      .fill({ color: sunlitColor(shadeColor(bodyColor, -18), "sun"), alpha: 0.88 })
3339:      .rect(cx - 1.6, cy - 6, 3.2, 1.2)
3340:      .fill({ color: mixColor(shadeColor(roofColor, 34), SUN_WARM_TINT, 0.25), alpha: 0.88 });
3341:    layer.addChild(chimney);
3342:  } else if (variant % 3 === 1 && building.facadeStyle !== "cottage") {

1. [SEVERITY critical] The “scene window” is not real streaming; 2x scene size still ships and scans the whole scene.
Evidence: `server/src/index.ts:1066-1089` attaches the generated draft payload as full `_meta.generatedDraftScene`.
Evidence: `web/src/App.tsx:346-380` accepts and stores the full `CityWorldScene` arrays before the renderer windows anything.
Evidence: `packages/core/src/voxel/cityWorldSceneWindow.ts:344-355` filters `commandBuffer.commands` globally, then only computes chunk ids for metadata.
Fix: Ship scene params or chunk packets, not full scenes; make `windowFor()` gather candidates from chunk command sets and hard-gate 2x payload + scan counts.

2. [SEVERITY high] Streaming refreshes and the 1.55 texture gate still rebuild by total teardown, causing GC/GPU churn on low-end phones.
Evidence: `web/src/CityWorldRenderer.tsx:1138-1146` removes and destroys every world child, then recreates every layer.
Evidence: `web/src/CityWorldRenderer.tsx:1211-1224` and `web/src/CityWorldRenderer.tsx:1333-1346` allocate fresh `Graphics` bands and per-building/prop containers every rebuild.
Evidence: `web/src/CityWorldRenderer.tsx:926-943` flips the material-texture gate into a full `setWindowRefreshKey()` rebuild.
Fix: Retain keyed display objects by command id, pool Graphics/Containers, and make texture detail a retained LOD toggle flushed only after zoom settles.

3. [SEVERITY high] The Graphics ceiling is a fake comfort metric because terrain/elevation path complexity is invisible.
Evidence: `web/src/CityWorldRenderer.tsx:574-586` counts DisplayObjects, not Graphics path commands, vertices, strokes, fills, or GPU upload cost.
Evidence: `web/src/CityWorldRenderer.tsx:1494-1558` appends multiple terrain paths per tile into merged Graphics.
Evidence: `web/src/CityWorldRenderer.tsx:1567-1610` and `web/src/CityWorldRenderer.tsx:1985-2053` add per-tile cliff/elevation loops inside those same objects.
Fix: Add path/vertex/upload counters and caps per visible window; cache terrain bands or promote terrain to mesh/texture layers before adding more elevation grammar.

4. [SEVERITY high] Render-on-demand does not actually park when water/fountain animation is visible.
Evidence: `web/src/CityWorldRenderer.tsx:462-478` keeps requesting rAF forever while `animatedRef` or `focusAnimatedRef` has targets.
Evidence: `packages/core/src/voxel/cityWorldCompiler.ts:1011-1013` and `:1065-1067` add permanent water shimmer/fountain props to curated Riverside.
Evidence: `scripts/verify-widget-performance.mjs:125-137` masks this by allowing up to 70 frames in 2s whenever animated targets exist.
Fix: Make ambient animation finite or interaction-triggered by default; require true parked idle after focus settles, including water scenes.

5. [SEVERITY high] Mobile DPR handling is optimistic, static, and under-tested.
Evidence: `web/src/CityWorldRenderer.tsx:528-535` always enables antialiasing and clamps DPR to 2 once; there is no low-end quality tier.
Evidence: `web/src/CityWorldRenderer.tsx:591-593` adds a full-stage post filter on the same mobile render target.
Evidence: `scripts/verify-emulator-audit.mjs:24-31` admits DSF3 starves in headless and downgrades mobile audit to DSF2; `scripts/verify-widget-performance.mjs:62` runs perf at desktop DSF1 only.
Fix: Add adaptive DPR/filter/antialias tiers from device memory + frame timing, and gate mobile DSF2/DSF3 with CPU-throttled rebuild, frame, and memory probes.
